Done. \u2705 I added both **Recalibrate** and **Export** into the Lovable build spec and pushed an updated project build.
### What you now have (once the build finishes)
##  Recalibrate Baseline
A new control labeled **[ RECALIBRATE BASELINE ]** (in the slide-out menu, and optionally mirrored in the footer depending on layout).
What it does:
* Pauses live visuals
* Enters **CALIBRATING** state for **3 seconds**
* Recomputes:
* baseline ambient audio energy
* baseline magnetic delta (MAG or PROXY)
* Logs the recalibration event
* Resumes live sensing using the new baseline, no reload needed
##  Export Events
A new menu control **[ EXPORT EVENTS ]**.
Exports the in-memory Event Archive as:
* \u2705 **JSON** download (required)
* \u2795 **CSV** download (optional if included by the build)
Export contents include:
* timestamp
* delta value
* threshold
* mode (MAG / PROXY)
* trigger type (AUTO hold / MANUAL hold)
* embedded disclaimer metadata inside the file
If you want, next step after this build is finished: I can add a tiny \u201cExport includes current sensor state\u201d option so each event row also includes MIC enabled/disabled, motion status, etc.
